Line chart of normalized close prices

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_compare.Rd

One line per coin, with buttons that switch the y axis between a linear and a log scale.

Usage

plot_compare(prices, mode = "light", base = NULL)

Arguments

prices

Prices from normalize_prices().

mode

"light" (the default) or "dark", to suit a light or dark page.

base

NULL for the normalized prices, or the name_symbol of the coin that prices, from relative_prices(), are relative to, for the title and a dashed line at 100, where a coin did as well as the base.

Value

A plotly object.

Examples

history <- get_history(c("Bitcoin (BTC)", "Ethereum (ETH)", "Solana (SOL)"))
plot_compare(normalize_prices(history))


# against Bitcoin
plot_compare(relative_prices(normalize_prices(history), "Bitcoin (BTC)"), base = "Bitcoin (BTC)")
